headline: Saudi Sovereign Wealth Fund Headquarter Hit in Houthi Missile Strike
summary: Riyadh's PIF Tower, the headquarters of the Saudi Public Investment Fund, sustained damage across multiple floors following a suspected Houthi missile attack. It marks the second attack on a major city landmark in under two weeks.
why: The Public Investment Fund manages over $700 billion in assets for Saudi Arabia. Escalating security threats to critical capital assets in Riyadh increase regional geopolitical risk premiums.
